description: Community-supported skills for Tough Tongue AI: build PM, consulting-case, system design, and MBA mock interviews, negotiation practice, slide-driven scenarios, and the study guides that go with them.

interface.shortDescription: Build mock interviews and study guides for Tough Tongue AI
interface.longDescription: Community-supported skills for Tough Tongue AI, the platform for tough conversations. Turn PM cases, consulting casebook cases, system design material, MBA video essays, and two-party negotiation cases into ready-to-run Tough Tongue AI practice scenarios, build slide-driven scenarios from a Gamma deck, and write the study guides that go with them. Scenario-building skills use the Tough Tongue AI MCP server, which the core toughtongue plugin provides.
defaultPrompt: Turn this PM case into a Tough Tongue AI mock interview.
Build a system design board interview for Design a URL Shortener.
Create a Kellogg video essay practice session.
Turn this negotiation case into a practice scenario.
